# The Chapter 11 semantic layer over the sample insurance warehouse.
# Written in the Apache Ossie shape (datasets, fields, relationships, metrics,

# (dim_policyholder, fct_premiums_v1, stg_premium_raw, dim_date) exist and are
# deliberately left out, so an agent working through the catalog never sees them.

revision: "2026-11-03"

datasets:
  - name: fct_policy_premium
    description: One row per premium transaction on a policy, including quotes that never bound.
    primary_key: [premium_id]
    fields:
      - {name: premium_id, type: integer}
      - {name: policy_id, type: integer}
      - {name: geo_id, type: integer, description: Region the policy is written in.}
      - {name: product_id, type: integer}
      - {name: agent_id, type: integer}
      - {name: premium_amt, type: decimal, description: Premium excluding taxes and fees.}
      - {name: premium_amt_gross, type: decimal, description: Premium including taxes and fees. No metric uses it.}
      - {name: cancellation_amt, type: decimal}
      - {name: status, type: string, description: "written, cancelled, or quote"}
      - {name: eff_dt, type: date}
  - name: dim_geography
    description: Region and territory lookup.
    primary_key: [geo_id]
    fields:
      - {name: geo_id, type: integer}
      - {name: region, type: string}
      - {name: territory, type: string}
  - name: dim_product
    description: Product line and distribution channel lookup.
    primary_key: [product_id]
    fields:
      - {name: product_id, type: integer}
      - {name: product_line, type: string}
      - {name: distribution_channel, type: string}
  - name: dim_agent
    description: Selling agents. geo_id is the agent's office, not the policy's region.
    primary_key: [agent_id]
    fields:
      - {name: agent_id, type: integer}
      - {name: agent_name, type: string}
      - {name: geo_id, type: integer}
  - name: fct_claims
    description: One row per claim.
    primary_key: [claim_id]
    fields:
      - {name: claim_id, type: integer}
      - {name: policy_id, type: integer}
      - {name: claim_amt, type: decimal, description: Amount claimed.}
      - {name: paid_amt, type: decimal, description: Amount paid. Final only when status is closed.}
      - {name: status, type: string, description: "open or closed"}
      - {name: severity, type: string}
      - {name: reported_dt, type: date}
      - {name: closed_dt, type: date}
  - name: fct_commissions
    description: Commission paid to agents on written premium.
    primary_key: [commission_id]
    access: [finance]
    fields:
      - {name: commission_id, type: integer}
      - {name: agent_id, type: integer}
      - {name: premium_id, type: integer}
      - {name: commission_amt, type: decimal}
      - {name: paid_dt, type: date}

relationships:
  # "on" is quoted deliberately: YAML 1.1 reads a bare on/off/yes/no as a boolean,
  # so an unquoted `on:` key becomes True and the join column disappears.
  - {name: premium_to_geography, from: fct_policy_premium, to: dim_geography, "on": geo_id}
  - {name: premium_to_product,   from: fct_policy_premium, to: dim_product,   "on": product_id}
  - {name: premium_to_agent,     from: fct_policy_premium, to: dim_agent,     "on": agent_id}
  - {name: agent_office,         from: dim_agent,          to: dim_geography, "on": geo_id}

dimensions:
  - {name: region,                 dataset: dim_geography, column: region, via: premium_to_geography}
  - {name: product_line,           dataset: dim_product,   column: product_line, via: premium_to_product}
  - {name: distribution_channel,   dataset: dim_product,   column: distribution_channel, via: premium_to_product}
  - {name: policy_effective_month, dataset: fct_policy_premium, expression: "strftime('%Y-%m', eff_dt)", grain: month}

metrics:
  - name: net_written_premium
    label: Net Written Premium
    description: Gross written premium less cancellations, recognized in the month the premium takes effect.
    expression: SUM(premium_amt) - SUM(cancellation_amt)
    grain: month
    time: eff_dt
    dimensions: [product_line, region, distribution_channel, policy_effective_month]
    owner: finance-reporting
    bindings:
      table: fct_policy_premium
      filters: ["status != 'quote'"]
    lineage: [fct_policy_premium.premium_amt, fct_policy_premium.cancellation_amt, fct_policy_premium.status]

    label: Gross Written Premium
    description: Premium written before cancellations, excluding taxes and fees, recognized in the month it takes effect.

    time: eff_dt

    owner: finance-reporting
    bindings:
      table: fct_policy_premium
      filters: ["status != 'quote'"]
    lineage: [fct_policy_premium.premium_amt, fct_policy_premium.status]
  - name: policies_written
    label: Policies Written
    description: Count of distinct policies with written premium in the period. Quotes are not policies.
    expression: COUNT(DISTINCT policy_id)
    grain: month
    time: eff_dt
    dimensions: [product_line, region, distribution_channel, policy_effective_month]
    owner: finance-reporting
    bindings:
      table: fct_policy_premium
      filters: ["status != 'quote'"]
    lineage: [fct_policy_premium.policy_id, fct_policy_premium.status]
  - name: claims_paid
    label: Claims Paid
    description: Amount paid on closed claims, recognized in the month the claim closed.
    expression: SUM(paid_amt)
    grain: month
    time: closed_dt
    dimensions: [severity, claim_closed_month]
    owner: claims-operations
    bindings:
      table: fct_claims
      filters: ["status = 'closed'"]
    lineage: [fct_claims.paid_amt, fct_claims.status, fct_claims.closed_dt]
  - name: commission_paid
    label: Commission Paid
    description: Commission paid to agents, recognized in the month paid.
    expression: SUM(commission_amt)
    grain: month
    time: paid_dt
    dimensions: [agent_name]
    owner: sales-compensation
    access: [finance]
    bindings:
      table: fct_commissions
      filters: []
    lineage: [fct_commissions.commission_amt, fct_commissions.paid_dt]

ai_context:
  instructions: >
    Resolve a business question to one metric, confirm every dimension appears in
    that metric's dimension list, then generate. Never name a table directly.
    If the question needs a metric that is not listed, say the catalog does not
    model it rather than approximating it from another metric.
  synonyms:
    net_written_premium: [NWP, net premium, written premium net of cancellations]
    gross_written_premium: [GWP, gross premium, written premium]
    policies_written: [policy count, new policies, number of policies]
    claims_paid: [paid claims, claim payments, losses paid]
    region: [geography, territory group]
    product_line: [line of business, LOB]
  example_queries:
    - "What was net written premium by region last quarter?"
    - "Show gross written premium by product line for 2026."

# Deliberately not modelled, so the reader sees a refusal rather than a guess.
not_modelled: [loss ratio, reinsurance recoveries, claim frequency]

3: CREATE TABLE dim_agent (agent_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, agent_name TEXT, geo_id INTEGER);
4: CREATE TABLE dim_policyholder (holder_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, policy_id INTEGER, holder_name TEXT, email TEXT, segment TEXT);
5: CREATE TABLE dim_date (date_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, month TEXT, quarter TEXT, year INTEGER);
6: CREATE TABLE fct_policy_premium (premium_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, policy_id INTEGER, geo_id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER, agent_id INTEGER, premium_amt REAL, premium_amt_gross REAL, cancellation_amt REAL, status TEXT, eff_dt TEXT);

9: CREATE TABLE fct_premiums_v1 (pol_id INTEGER, region_name TEXT, prem REAL, eff_date TEXT);
10: CREATE TABLE stg_premium_raw (load_id INTEGER, premium_id INTEGER, policy_id INTEGER, geo_id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER, premium_amt REAL, cancellation_amt REAL, status TEXT, eff_dt TEXT);
